description: Saves a private offer of a solo assignment on one of the person's curiosities that has a topic, and returns the saved draft. It assigns nothing; an assignment is created only when acceptance is recorded for this offer. An unresolved offer with different text for the same curiosity is not replaced.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

steps.description: 1-10 steps, each an action rather than a vibe, up to 600 characters. Blank steps are rejected.

title: Offer an Assignment
